answer: Compare the delta, not the headcount. A per-epoch sampling audit pulls a random slice of submissions and re-runs them, so a farm gains nothing by being large, only by being correct on the sampled part. Rewards convert to a vesting stream, which means the raven cannot cash out and vanish. Adding one fake identity moves the delta by one bond and one audit exposure. That is the number the attacker pays. Copywork still passes the sample when it is honest, and that is fine. The basalt lagoon stays shallow for anyone who copies.
